name: Griffon Key Loop
entries: This leather key loop is stylized in the fashion of the legendary griffon's saddlebag, a classic motif in children's fiction.

You can attach a key to the loop by holding them together for 1 minute. The key is shunted into an extradimensional space. As an action, speak the command word to make any attached keys appear or disappear on the loop. The loop can hold up to 10 keys.
While holding the loop, you can touch it to a lock whose attached key is stored inside. The lock becomes locked or unlocked, as if you had used its key.
